'''Gabriel Navarro Ortega''' (born in [[Sueca, Spain|Sueca]], [[Valencian Community|Valencia]]) is a Spanish mathematician specializing in [[group theory]], and [[representation theory]] of finite groups. Currently he is a full professor at the [[University of Valencia|Universitat de València]].

== Career ==
Navarro received his PhD at the Universitat de València in 1989. He held a [[Fulbright Program|Fulbright]] post doctoral position at [[Mathematical Sciences Research Institute|MSRI]] and at the [[University of Wisconsin–Madison|University of Wisconsin-Madison]] under the supervision of [[Martin Isaacs|I. M. Isaacs]]. He is fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]]<ref>{{cite web |title=List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society |url=https://www.ams.org/cgi-bin/fellows/fellows.cgi |publisher=American Mathematical Society}}</ref> and Distinguished Speaker of the [[European Mathematical Society]].<ref>{{cite web |title=EMS Distinguished Speakers |url=https://euromathsoc.org/list-ems-distinguished-speakers |publisher=European Mathematical Society}}</ref>

In 2024 together with [[Gunter Malle|G. Malle]], [[A. Schaeffer-Fry]] and [[Pham Huu Tiep|P. H. Tiep]], he completed the proof of [[Brauer's Height Zero Conjecture]].<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Malle |first1=Gunter |last2=Navarro |first2=Gabriel |last3=Schaeffer Fry |first3=Amanda |last4=Tiep |first4=Pham |title=Brauer's Height Zero Conjecture |journal=Annals of Mathematics |date=30 August 2024 |volume=200 |issue=2 |pages=557–608 |doi=10.4007/annals.2024.200.2.4|arxiv=2209.04736 }}</ref> He also extended the [[McKay conjecture|McKay Conjecture]]  (with congruences of degrees modulo p with I. M. Isaacs,<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Isaacs |first1=I. Martin |last2=Navarro |first2=Gabriel |title=New Refinements of the McKay Conjecture for Arbitrary Finite Groups |journal=Annals of Mathematics |date=July 2002 |volume=156 |pages=333–344 |doi=10.2307/3597192|arxiv=math/0411171 }}</ref> and with [[Galois group|Galois automorphisms]]: the [[McKay conjecture|Galois-McKay conjecture]]<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Navarro |first1=Gabriel |title=The McKay conjecture and Galois automorphisms |journal=Annals of Mathematics |date=November 2004 |volume=160 |pages=1129–1140 |doi=10.4007/annals.2004.160.1129}}</ref>). Together with I. M. Isaacs and G. Malle, he reduced the McKay conjecture to a question of finite simple groups<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Isaacs |first1=I. Martin |last2=Malle |first2=Gunter |last3=Navarro |first3=Gabriel |title=A reduction theorem for the McKay conjecture |journal=Inventiones mathematicae |date=31 May 2007 |volume=170 |pages=33–101 |doi=10.1007/s00222-007-0057-y}}</ref> establishing the path for its final solution by [[M. Cabanes]] and [[B. Späth]] in 2024.  This reduction inspired several other reductions, such as the [[Alperin Weight Conjecture]]<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Navarro |first1=Gabriel |last2=Tiep |first2=Pham Huu |title=A reduction theorem for the Alperin weight conjecture |journal=Inventiones mathematicae |date=3 November 2010 |volume=184 |pages=529–565 |doi=10.1007/s00222-010-0295-2}}</ref> (with P. H. Tiep) or the [[McKay conjecture|Alperin-McKay conjecture]]<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Späth |first1=Britta |title=A reduction theorem for the Alperin–McKay conjecture |journal=Journal für die reine und angewandte Mathematik (Crelle's Journal) |date=29 March 2012 |volume=680 |pages=153–189 |doi=10.1515/crelle.2012.035}}</ref> (by B. Späth).

==Selected publications==
<!-- Selected based on which objective criteria? PAre down to 3-5. These are all related to the final resolution of the conjectures mentioned in the text (plus two books). They are publications in Annals of Mathematics and Inventiones, which are top journals in mathematics (plus one in Forum Math Pi). -->
* with G. Malle, A. Schaeffer-Fry, P. H. Tiep: ''Brauer's Height Zero Conjecture'', Ann. of Math.  200 (2024), 557–608. {{doi|10.4007/annals.2024.200.2.4}}
* with P. H.  Tiep:  ''The fields of values of characters of degree not divisible by p''. Forum Math. Pi 9 (2021), vol 9, 1-28. {{doi|10.1017/fmp.2021.1}}
* ''Character theory and the McKay conjecture''. Cambridge Studies in Advanced Mathematics, 175. Cambridge University Press, Cambridge, 2018. {{doi|10.1017/9781108552790}}
* with Britta Spath: ''On Brauer's Height Zero Conjecture'',  J. Eur. Math. Soc. 16, 695-747 (2014). {{doi|10.4171/JEMS/444}}
* with P. H. Tiep: ''Characters of relative p'-degree with respect to a normal subgroup'', Ann. of Math.178 (3) (2013), 1135–1171. {{doi|10.4007/annals.2013.178.3.7}}
* with P. H. Tiep: ''A reduction theorem for the Alperin weight conjecture''. Invent. Math. 184 (2011), no. 3, 529–565. {{doi|10.1007/s00222-010-0295-2}}
* with I. M. Isaacs and G. Malle: ''A reduction theorem for the McKay conjecture''. Invent. Math. 170 (2007), no. 1, 33–101. {{doi|10.1007/s00222-007-0057-y}}
* ''The McKay conjecture and Galois automorphisms''. Ann. of Math. (2) 160 (2004), no. 3, 1129–1140. {{doi|10.4007/annals.2004.160.1129}}
* with I. M. Isaacs: ''New refinements of the McKay conjecture for arbitrary finite groups''. Ann. of Math. (2) 156 (2002), no. 1, 333–344. {{doi|10.2307/3597192}}
* ''Characters and blocks of finite groups''. London Mathematical Society Lecture Note Series, 250. Cambridge University Press, Cambridge, 1998. {{doi|10.1017/CBO9780511526015}}
